questions.question: Which country is the only one in the world to share a land border with Portugal?
questions.fun_fact: Spain shares the entire eastern and northern land border of Portugal on the Iberian Peninsula.

questions.question: What is the atomic number of the chemical element carbon?
questions.fun_fact: Carbon has an atomic number of 6, meaning every carbon atom has six protons in its nucleus.

questions.question: Who was the second President of the United States?
questions.fun_fact: John Adams served as the second US president from 1797 to 1801, succeeding George Washington.

questions.question: Which 1999 science fiction action film popularized the 'bullet time' visual effect and stars Keanu Reeves as Neo?
questions.fun_fact: The Matrix was written and directed by the Wachowskis and became a massive cultural phenomenon.

questions.question: Gorgonzola is a famous blue-veined cheese traditionally produced in which European country?
questions.fun_fact: Gorgonzola is one of Italy's oldest-known blue cheeses, originating from the town of Gorgonzola near Milan.

questions.question: What is a group of flamingos called?
questions.fun_fact: A group of flamingos is wonderfully referred to as a flamboyance, perfectly matching their vibrant pink feathers.

questions.question: In the sport of golf, what term is used for a score of one stroke under par on a single hole?
questions.fun_fact: A birdie means scoring one stroke under par, whereas an eagle is two strokes under par.

questions.question: What linguistic term describes a word formed from the initial letters of other words, such as NASA or scuba?
questions.fun_fact: Acronyms are pronounced as distinct words, unlike initialisms like FBI, where each letter is spoken individually.

questions.question: Which planet in our solar system has the Great Dark Spot, a storm comparable in size to Jupiter's Great Red Spot?
questions.fun_fact: Discovered by Voyager 2 in 1989, Neptune's Great Dark Spot was a massive storm system that later vanished when observed by the Hubble Space Telescope.

questions.question: The historic D-Day landings of World War II took place along the heavily fortified coastline of which region?
questions.fun_fact: Operation Overlord commenced on June 6, 1944, with amphibious landings on five beaches along the Normandy coast of France.
